service.en: New work permit for a domestic worker
service.ar: تصريح عمل جديد لعامل خدمة منزلية
service.ur: گھریلو ملازم کا نیا ورک پرمٹ

about: Get a work permit so a household can hire a domestic worker.
note: Requirements read from the official MOHRE service page on the checked date. Field labels sit behind sign-in, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Citizen employers need a valid Emirates ID; resident employers or investors need a valid residence permit
Worker must not hold a valid work permit
Worker's passport valid for at least 3 months
Worker is 18 or older, up to age 60
The worker needs an adequate insurance policy on the employer's file
documents: Employer's passport copy (citizens include the unified number page)
Worker's passport copy and colour photo
For expatriate employers: housing proof and a salary certificate or 3 months of bank statements showing at least 25,000 AED monthly family income
Marriage contract and spouse's visa for expatriate employers
Written justification if the employer already has more than five domestic workers
fees: Fees depend on the emirate and permit length
Business centres may add a commission of up to 72 AED
Otherwise free on the website and app
timing: Permit lasts 2 years for citizens, 1 year for residents
